The test `['tests.test_exporters.XmlItemExporterTest.test_nonstring_types_item(self)']` failed.
The test looks like:

```python
379 :     def test_nonstring_types_item(self):
380 :         item = self._get_nonstring_types_item()
381 :         self.assertExportResult(item, # error occurred here
382 :             b'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n'
383 :             b'<items>'
384 :                b'<item>'
385 :                    b'<float>3.14</float>'
386 :                    b'<boolean>False</boolean>'
387 :                    b'<number>22</number>'
388 :                    b'<time>2015-01-01 01:01:01</time>'
389 :                b'</item>'
390 :             b'</items>'
391 :         )
```

It failed with the following error message and call stack:

```
AttributeError: 'bool' object has no attribute 'decode'
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/user/BugsInPy/temp/projects/scrapy/tests/test_exporters.py", line 381, in test_nonstring_types_item
    self.assertExportResult(item,
  File "/home/user/BugsInPy/temp/projects/scrapy/tests/test_exporters.py", line 326, in assertExportResult
    ie.export_item(item)
  File "/home/user/BugsInPy/temp/projects/scrapy/scrapy/exporters.py", line 132, in export_item
    self._export_xml_field(name, value)
  File "/home/user/BugsInPy/temp/projects/scrapy/scrapy/exporters.py", line 148, in _export_xml_field
    self._xg_characters(serialized_value)
  File "/home/user/BugsInPy/temp/projects/scrapy/scrapy/exporters.py", line 159, in _xg_characters
    serialized_value = serialized_value.decode(self.encoding)
```

Start by calling the `get_covered_packages` function.

Conclusion: The test `test_nonstring_types_item` checks whether non-string types such as `float`, `boolean`, `number`, and `time` are correctly handled by the XML export functionality in the `XmlItemExporter`. However, the error message indicates that there is an attempt to decode a boolean value (`False`) using `.decode()`, which raises an AttributeError. This suggests that the method `_export_xml_field` in the `scrapy.exporters.XmlItemExporter` class is not properly handling non-string types before attempting to serialize them as XML characters.

Following the execution path, we find that:
- The `_xg_characters` method attempts to decode a value using `.decode()`, which raises an AttributeError when called on a boolean (`False`) or any other non-string object.
- In the test case `test_nonstring_types_item`, a boolean value (`False`) is exported without being properly handled.

Recommendations for fixing this issue:
```
scrapy.exporters.XmlItemExporter._export_xml_field(ArgType)
scrapy.exporters.XmlItemExporter._xg_characters(ArgType)
```
